description: Asks the text CStr returns for numbers of many magnitudes (switch to exponent form, tiny values, repeating fractions, a Single, Currency and Decimal operand), Boolean, and Date operands with and without a time part; and what Str returns for sign and zero. Dates are rendered in the oracle's locale, which is recorded with the run. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
